images.caption: 181006-N-UK248-1005 SAN FRANCISCO (Oct. 5, 2018) Members of the "Prevailing Winds" a woodwind quintet, apart of Navy Band Southwest, perform at the San Francisco Conservatory of Music during San Francisco Fleet Week (SFFW) 2018. SFFW is an opportunity for the American public to meet their Navy, Marine Corps and Coast Guard teams and experience America's sea services. During fleet week, service members participate in various community service events, showcase capabilities and equipment to the community, and enjoy the hospitality of San Francisco and its surrounding areas. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Kristina Young/Released)
